description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of TaggingAdImage
description_zh: 本文介绍广告素材分析TaggingAdImage的语法及示例
name: TaggingAdImage

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

Data.description_en: The returned result data. After the asynchronous task executes successfully, call the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and perform JSON deserialization on the Result field to obtain this data
Data.description_zh:
返回的结果数据内容。
该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

TagInfo.description_en: The labels. Currently, only scene and human are returned. For specific values, see the "TagInfo field parameter description" table below
TagInfo.description_zh: 标签。目前仅输出scene（场景）和human（人）。具体取值请参见下表“TagInfo字段参数说明”

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
